description: Fetch a single ReliefWeb report by its numeric ID with full body text, file attachments, and all metadata. Use after reliefweb_search_reports to retrieve document content — body is excluded from search results to manage context budget. Report bodies can be 10–100KB. A record over the response budget comes back as a section outline naming every section and its byte size; re-call with sections to pull only the ones needed. Nothing is truncated on either path.

id.description: ReliefWeb numeric report ID. Obtained from reliefweb_search_reports results.

sections.description: Sections of the report record to return, named by the sections[].name values an outline response lists. Omit for the whole record, or for a section outline when the record is over the response budget. Identity metadata — the record's ID, its name, and its canonical URL — comes back alongside whatever is requested. The call is self-contained — the record is re-fetched and sliced, so no prior call has to be repeated.

items.description: A section name exactly as the outline response spelled it.

name: reliefweb_get_report

body.description: Full report body text (HTML). Present for most reports; absent for binary-only documents.

countries.description: All countries tagged on this report.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No report found with the given ID. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fileUrls.description: Direct file download URLs attached to this report.

headlineSummary.description: Short editorial summary from the headline block, when present.

kind.description: full when the record — or the sections asked for — is returned in whole; outline when the record exceeded the response budget and only its section index is returned.

outlineNotice.description: How to re-call this tool for specific sections of the record.

primaryCountry.description: Primary country name for this report.

sections.description: Every section of the record, largest first. Pass the names back in `sections` to retrieve them.

items.description: One retrievable section of the record: its name and its serialized size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this report.

title: Get ReliefWeb Report
